tools.name: read_text_file
tools.title: Read text file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file as text. Use this when you need to examine a single file; use read_multiple_files for several. Only works within allowed directories.

head.description: If set, return only the first N lines

tail.description: If set, return only the last N lines

tools.name: read_multiple_files
tools.title: Read multiple files
tools.description: Read the contents of several files at once. Use this when comparing or analysing files together. A failed read of one file does not stop the others.

tools.name: write_file
tools.title: Write file
tools.description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file with new content. Use with caution: it overwrites without warning. Calling it again with the same content leaves the same file, so it is safe to retry.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.title: Edit file
tools.description: Make line-based edits to a text file. Each edit replaces an exact text match. Use dryRun to preview a git-style diff first. A retry after success fails because the old text no longer matches.

tools.name: create_directory
tools.title: Create directory
tools.description: Create a directory, including parents. Succeeds silently if it already exists, so it is safe to retry. Use this when setting up a project layout.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.title: List directory
tools.description: List files and directories in a path, marked [FILE] or [DIR]. Use this when you need to see what a directory holds.

tools.name: move_file
tools.title: Move file
tools.description: Move or rename a file or directory. Fails if the destination exists, so a retry after success fails instead of moving twice.

tools.name: search_files
tools.title: Search files
tools.description: Recursively search for files whose names match a glob pattern. Use this when you know part of a file name but not where it is.

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.title: Get file info
tools.description: Return size, timestamps, type and permissions of a file or directory. Use this when you need metadata without reading content.

tools.name: list_allowed_directories
tools.title: List allowed directories
tools.description: Return the directories this server may access. Use this before other calls to see which paths are allowed.
